prereqs: Node 18+. Printer reachable on the LAN (OctoPrint, Klipper/Moonraker, PrusaLink, Duet, Repetier, Bambu LAN mode). Put real values in your OS env or .env, never in this file.
claude_code_command: claude mcp add printer --env PRINTER_HOST=${PRINTER_HOST} --env PRINTER_TYPE=octoprint --env API_KEY=${OCTOPRINT_API_KEY} -- npx -y mcp-3d-printer-server
note: Placeholders only. Never commit real keys; keep secrets in .env or the OS keychain.
